analysis_type: prospective descriptive calibration audit; not a causal effect estimate
failure_boundaries: Prospective shifts transport only if calibration-period level/category gaps remain stable.
History-baseline CE/RW require returning users with an observed history baseline.
Cell-equal CE and exposure-row RW target different production aggregations.
Evaluation conditions on frozen users present in both test logs and frozen video support.
The second rolling origin overlaps the primary test and is not independent replication.
The oracle contemporaneous CE reads the test-random grand mean and is not deployable.

method_estimands.category_vector_shift: naive plus frozen category calibration gap
method_estimands.grand_mean_shift: naive plus frozen scalar calibration gap
method_estimands.oracle_contemporaneous_ce: test-standard contemporaneous user residuals plus test-random grand mean; non-deployable diagnostic upper bound
method_estimands.prospective_ce_cell_equal: history-baseline residual averaged equally over observed test standard user-category cells, plus frozen random calibration anchor
method_estimands.prospective_rw_row_weighted: history-baseline residual averaged over test standard exposure rows, plus frozen random calibration anchor

method_roles.oracle_contemporaneous_ce: non-deployable upper-bound diagnostic; uses test random grand mean
method_roles.prospective_ce_cell_equal: deployable after history/calibration; equal observed user-category cells
method_roles.prospective_rw_row_weighted: deployable after history/calibration; standard exposure-row target

category_vector_shift_minus_oracle_conte.definition: category_vector_shift minus oracle_contemporaneous_ce within each draw

prospective_ce_cell_equal_minus_grand_me.definition: prospective_ce_cell_equal minus grand_mean_shift within each draw

prospective_rw_row_weighted_minus_grand_.definition: prospective_rw_row_weighted minus grand_mean_shift within each draw

prospective_rw_row_weighted_minus_prospe.definition: prospective_rw_row_weighted minus prospective_ce_cell_equal within each draw
